calibration.axes: x right, y down, z forward
calibration.basis: Publisher recommends ROS default intrinsics without undistortion for pre-registered PNG depth. Depth is already rescaled and expressed in RGB optical coordinates; apply no extra correction or IR-to-RGB transform. This is the recommended approximation, not newly measured calibration.

generation: Every indexed depth frame with its fixed nearest timestamp-associated RGB image. Native grayscale, Shi-Tomasi detection, forward/backward sparse LK, source-depth metric PnP RANSAC; invert previous-to-current exactly once for the unchanged world chain. Retain the original 0.5 full-cloud support guard at 0.1m. No reference initialization, scale fit, lost-track reset or future-frame selection. PnP uses the existing native RGB-D API deterministic RANSAC defaults plus the fixed 2px threshold.
scope: Previously observed development sequence. The same original image controls and acceptance gates are fixed before new image fitting. Prior point-based errors remain. No held-out, newly measured calibration or general motion-quality claim.

acceptance.basis: Unchanged engineering completeness/coverage/ATE/RPE limits from the previous plane study. Fixed before first image-tracking/PnP fitting; not publisher accuracy requirements or physical calibration guarantees.
